name: thunderbird-translate-fork
description: A translation add-on which uses the Gemini API to translate your mails in one click.

scripts.build:web-ext: npm run build:prod && web-ext build --source-dir=dist --overwrite-dest -n thunderbird-translate-fork.xpi
scripts.build:xpi: npm run build:prod && cd dist && zip -oX -r ../thunderbird-translate-fork.xpi * && cd ..
